from pathlib import Path
import sys, types, unittest
root = Path.cwd()
package = types.ModuleType("hermes_cli")
package.__path__ = []
sys.modules["hermes_cli"] = package
for name in ("friday_native_control", "friday_native_supervision"):
    path = root / "docs/checkpoints/2026-10-13-source96-delta/Source/native41/hermes/hermes_cli" / (name + ".py.txt")
    module = types.ModuleType("hermes_cli." + name)
    module.__file__ = str(path)
    sys.modules[module.__name__] = module
    exec(compile(path.read_bytes(), str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(str(root / "tests"), pattern="test_dsh_adapter.py")
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
